hazard_source: robot mass ~146 kg (102.2 base + 43.7 superstructure; rev B CAD)
hazardous_event: robot drops or tips while lifted; foot/hand crushing
inherent_design: marked lifting points/fork pockets; transport lock for arms; shipped on pallet
info_for_use: mass on nameplate (1.7.3); lifting procedure; PPE safety shoes

hazard_source: scanner field sets, speed limits, safety-controller logic configured on site
hazardous_event: wrong or too small protective field -> collision
inherent_design: field sets computed by tool from SF3/SF4 speed tables; config locked by password + checksum; site cannot edit safety params
info_for_use: commissioning checklist + field validation report with test pieces

hazard_source: base travel up to 1.2 m/s (industrial) / 0.8 m/s (public) (ASSUMED limits, drive max 2.5 m/s)
inherent_design: speed capped in drive (SMS 1.2 m/s, SLS); reverse <= 0.3 m/s permanent SLSa in each drive (rear field 0.35 m in FAST); rounded chamfered body 95 mm; rubber edge | rev B2: SS1-t (SLS request at once, STO at 1.2 s after a complete 1.5 m/s2 ramp); fields CALC s.7 rev B2 (t_logic 54 ms SOURCED)
info_for_use: max speed, operating zones, aisle widths per ISO 3691-4 in manual; reverse travel only at <= 0.3 m/s | residual: ramp failure (non-safe part) -> stop bounded by SWD SLS-STO at 1.0 s, distance > field (CALC s.7 info table)
verification: TP-01,TP-02,TP-05; TP-01b ramp-failure injection; TP-03a cat-0 distance

hazard_source: 2D scan plane 184.5 mm; obstacles above plane (table tops, open drawers, overhangs, wheelchair footrests)
hazardous_event: superstructure hits overhang -> falling objects / hit to seated person
inherent_design: depth camera obstacle layer (non-safety); smooth superstructure; low travel speed in public mode
info_for_use: site requirements: no overhangs in travel paths or mark as keep-out zones; residual risk stated

hazard_source: drive wheels and D100 castors, ground clearance 32 mm
hazardous_event: foot run over / toe trapped under body edge
inherent_design: clearance <= 32 mm with body edge outside wheels; field covers full contour incl. sides; slow rotation
info_for_use: keep feet clear; wear closed shoes (operators)
verification: TP-05 (70 mm leg test piece at contour)

hazard_source: robot rotation incl. superstructure (fixed to base), swept radius ~440 mm with arms parked (base ~432 mm ESTIMATE, superstructure 440 mm CAD)
hazardous_event: person or limb trapped between rotating robot and wall/counter
inherent_design: rotation centre = base centre; rotation only with arms parked and at SLS 0.3 m/s wheel speed; limited yaw rate
info_for_use: min clearance 500 mm (ISO 13854 body) around docking/working positions; rotate on the spot only with arms parked

hazard_source: drive wheels and castors under the base with covers open
hazardous_event: entanglement/cut during service with covers open
inherent_design: fixed guards removable only with tool (1.3.8.1); service with key disconnect open

hazard_source: OpenArm 2.0 arms, no safety-rated speed/force monitoring
hazardous_event: arm hits person reaching in; hand crushed between arm and tray
inherent_design: arms work only above tray; low speed/torque limits in firmware (non-safety)
safeguards_SF: SF7 (arms powered only with arm protective field clear incl. arm reach + separation distance),SF6,SF1
info_for_use: no hand-over to hands; take items from tray only after green light

hazard_source: certified DC cobot arms
inherent_design: PFL limits per EN ISO 10218-2:2025 biomechanical annex; rounded grippers; padded tray edges
safeguards_SF: SF16 (cobot safety controller: PFL, SLS, SLP, SS1),SF7
info_for_use: contact body regions allowed; no face-height motion in public mode

hazard_source: arms without brakes; stop cat 0 or power loss (battery cut, E-stop)
hazardous_event: arm falls under gravity onto hand/forearm/child head; payload dropped
inherent_design: MUST ADD: spring-applied brakes or gravity compensation (GAPS G1); travel/park pose on mechanical rests; arms not above head height of bystanders
safeguards_SF: SF1 (arms stop cat 1 when energy available),SF8
info_for_use: R&D variant: not for public until G1 closed; mark residual risk

hazard_source: gripper jaws
inherent_design: grip force limit; gripper jaw gap and force per biomechanical limits

hazard_source: hot coffee cup (~70-85 C ASSUMED) and 2x3 kg payload
hazardous_event: cup dropped/spilled on person; scald; impact on foot
inherent_design: hand-over via tray only; cup holders with lids; tray rim; objects in tray while driving; serving temperature limited
safeguards_SF: SF8 (FAST travel only with arms parked),SF4
info_for_use: hot drink warning label; take cup from tray; objects travel in the tray, never in the hands

hazard_source: 24 V capsule machine heater, hot water/steam, hot surfaces
hazardous_event: burn on surfaces > EN ISO 13732-1 thresholds; hot water ejection when opening
inherent_design: enclosure SH06; machine out of public reach; outlet only above cup holder; hot water enclosed in an EN 60335-2-15 appliance. PLr: S1 (slight, reversible burn) F2 (barista operation all shift) P1 -> b; if rated S2 -> PLr c -> K4 on safe output + U7 remote OFF (+1 EF 8DI4DO)
safeguards_SF: SF15 (K4 off on E-stop and in SERVICE, Cat B PL b; cover interlock: appliance-internal per EN 60335-2-15 or a spare PNOZ input)
info_for_use: warning pictogram; let cool 10 min before service

hazard_source: Actuonix P16 cup shuttle on MGN12
inherent_design: low force actuator; enclosure; rounded carriage

hazard_source: superstructure CoG ~911 mm, arms extended, braking, ramps, castor springs
hazardous_event: tip-over onto person or robot falls
inherent_design: static/dynamic stability calc; speed/decel limits by configuration; max slope in spec; arms parked while travelling fast
info_for_use: max slope, floor flatness, no thresholds > x mm; never drive with arms extended to the side or rear

hazard_source: people leaning on, pushing, children climbing, sitting on tray
inherent_design: stability margin vs horizontal push >= 170 N at shoulder height (sim value, to verify); no step-like surfaces; tray not climbable
info_for_use: signage 'do not climb/sit'; supervisor in public events

hazard_source: power restore, reset, mode change
inherent_design: no auto restart in drives/arms after power return

hazard_source: robot reversing into dock; dock body
hazardous_event: foot/hand pinched between rear of robot and dock
inherent_design: docking at creep speed; reduced rear field shaped to the dock contour (no muting)

hazard_source: slope, power loss
inherent_design: spring-applied drive brakes (fail-safe SBC)

hazard_source: T24 traction bus from DC-DC; regen overvoltage; DC-DC failure
hazardous_event: loss of traction control or uncontrolled stop
inherent_design: 27 V DSR 50/5 clamps MANDATORY on T24 (SWD FW >= 1.1.4 disables phase-short braking if the supply cannot accept current, VERIFICATION E1); 27 V < DDR OVP 28.8 V < SWD alert 32 V; ORing; STO on fault; parking brake on power loss
verification: TP-03 (power-loss stop), TP-03b (6 % holding), TP-14 (worst-case regen); supplier OK no longer needed (VERIFICATION E1)

hazard_source: glass, mirrors, black low-reflective clothing, sunlight on scanners, dirty window
inherent_design: Type 3 scanners with window contamination monitoring; dual scanner coverage
info_for_use: site survey; cleaning interval for scanner windows

hazard_source: stairs, edges, ramps not detected by 2D scanner
hazardous_event: robot drives off edge and falls/tips on person below
inherent_design: keep-out zones in map; depth camera cliff detection (non-safety)
info_for_use: SITE REQUIREMENT: physical barriers at edges/stairs (ISO 3691-4 operating zones); residual risk

hazard_source: 48 V DC bus (40-58.4 V), spilled liquids
inherent_design: PELV per EN 60204-1; IPXXB enclosures; IP54 base (ASSUMED target); IP54 deck grommet; drip protection under coffee

hazard_source: battery short circuit (2x90 A peak, 3.07 kWh)
inherent_design: F0 Siemens 3NA3830 100 A gG NH000 (250 V DC, 25 kA DC, SOURCED); 60 A internal fuse per pack (SOURCED); every B48 device >= 20 kA DC breaking (prospective Isc unpublished, V:D6); contactor; cable sizing EN 60204-1; separate fusing per branch

hazard_source: LFP packs (IEC 62619), mounting, mechanical damage
inherent_design: LFP chemistry; BMS with main relay (IEC 62619 CB); packs lying on their side (allowed: only upside down is forbidden, Discover 805-0027 s.9.2) with >= 50 mm free at the top cover and hold-downs; 48 V application cut-off K0V; forced ventilation
info_for_use: fire extinguisher type in manual (3.5.2); storage SoC

hazard_source: RoboPad dock contacts, 48 V 11.3 A (NPB-750-48)
hazardous_event: contact with live pads or metal object bridging pads
inherent_design: pads dead unless Hall sensor + 10 k signature + handshake over Wi-Fi/Ethernet (RoboPad has no wireless CAN); dock OV relay 59 V (RoboPad 60 V fault limit); ideal diode prevents back-feed; current limit

hazard_source: dock charger NPB-750-48 (EMC Class B), mains cable
hazardous_event: shock from mains parts of dock
inherent_design: certified charger (EN 60335-2-29); dock enclosure IPXXB; RCD at outlet

hazard_source: DC-link capacitors in drives/DC-DC
inherent_design: precharge/discharge resistor; 48 V only

hazard_source: motors, DC-DC, shunt regulators
inherent_design: inside enclosure; shunt regulators guarded

hazard_source: drives, fans, coffee pump
inherent_design: low-noise drives and fans

hazard_source: nanoScan3 (class 1), Orbbec IR projector (class 1)
inherent_design: class 1 products only

hazard_source: Wi-Fi radio, motor magnets
inherent_design: certified module, low power; antenna > 20 cm from accessible surface

hazard_source: external disturbances on safety and nav electronics
hazardous_event: spurious motion or loss of safety function
inherent_design: certified safety components; shielding, grounding plan; safety functions fail to safe state

hazard_source: ROS 2 / Nav2 / ML policies / LLM commands
inherent_design: safety layer independent of ML/compute: hardware SF limit all motion; ML frozen in the field (no online learning); speed/space limits in safety controller + drives
info_for_use: ML is not safety relevant (Annex I check)

hazard_source: Wi-Fi, remote supervision, USB, updates
hazardous_event: remote attacker changes missions or safety config; malicious update
inherent_design: safety config not reachable from network (separate interface, password, CRC); signed updates; secure boot (ASSUMED Jetson); logs of interventions (1.1.9, 1.2.1(f))

hazard_source: loss of supervisor link (3.2.4)
inherent_design: heartbeat watchdog: link loss -> protective stop + safe park
safeguards_SF: SF17 (CE-only; not yet in the electrical package)

hazard_source: children, elderly, visually impaired, crowds, dogs; grabbing arms; riding
inherent_design: public mode: lower speeds, bigger fields, warning light + sound, intent signalling (1.1.6(g))

hazard_source: sudden moves near people, unclear intent
inherent_design: predictable slow motion; light ring shows intended direction; voice states it is an AI (AI Act Art 50)

hazard_source: battery removal (14 kg each), refilling cups/capsules, low service points
inherent_design: refill points 0.8-1.2 m height; battery handles

hazard_source: cleaning with liquids; food-contact parts
inherent_design: key disconnect lockable (1.6.3); food-contact parts removable and cleanable (2.1)

hazard_source: manual jog of base/arms
inherent_design: reduced speed in manual mode; hold-to-run + enabling device

hazard_source: dock, robot parked in passage
hazardous_event: trip over dock or parked robot
inherent_design: dock flat, contrasting colour; park positions off walkways

hazard_source: coffee heater 300 W, PA12 shells
inherent_design: thermal fuse in heater; UL 94 V-0 or HB as per assessment; fusing of 24 V coffee branch

hazard_source: battery removal, WEEE
inherent_design: terminal covers, removable packs
